observations.behavior: Captures HTTP status and error codes from ApiError into an object passed to captureException, while preserving the same message string for setError.

observations.posthog_connection: Enriches telemetry with backend-specific diagnostics rather than generic messages, aiding support debugging of activation failures.

observations.behavior: Replaces a conditional click handler that could trigger setup or activation retry with a single fixed action pointing only to retry.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes user-visible recovery behavior by removing branching logic in the GitHub failure path, potentially reducing recovery options depending on implementation intent.

observations.limitations: The chunk mixes three distinct behaviors: adding structured diagnostics, enriching existing events, and removing conditional recovery actions. No tier-3 systemic change or broader component dependency shift is demonstrated; benefits are bounded to inbox activation handling. P1.F4 adds tests but no runtime changes; P1.F2 removes functionality without equivalent replacement shown. Tier assignment relies solely on diagnostic additions which do not establish wider reliability or adoption value.
